summary: Closed the counting half of the election-eligibility account: the quorum is half of remotes plus witnesses, so a witness's vote counts, and a candidate explicitly drops a vote response from an observer before tallying, becoming leader at quorum grants and stepping down at quorum rejections. Together with the grant-side trace this shows observers influence no election outcome while witnesses answer and are counted. Added one knowledge entry and an explained, refuted account, noting that the filter checks only the observer map and that the count re-validates nothing beyond the sender check. No execution requested.
